hook_title.fr: Il pouvait se venger. Il a fait mieux

loop_note: Histoire complète : le dernier plan reprend le garage du premier, cette fois avec l'enseigne Bruno et Fils.

fr.title: Il pouvait se venger. Il a fait mieux 🐕
fr.description: Monsieur Renard a volé le garage de Papa Bruno avec un contrat piégé. Des mois plus tard, par une nuit d'orage, c'est Renard qui est en panne… et seul Bruno peut l'aider. Qu'aurais-tu fait ? Voix et images générées par IA.

cast.name: Bruno
cast.look: an anthropomorphic golden retriever father standing upright, about 40, kind tired brown eyes, grease-stained blue work overalls over a red checked shirt, a wrench in his back pocket
cast.voice: a warm deep voice of a kind father in his forties

cast.name: Tom
cast.look: an anthropomorphic golden retriever puppy standing upright, about 8 years old, big bright eyes, a red cap, oversized blue overalls rolled up at the ankles
cast.voice: a sweet voice of an eight-year-old boy

cast.name: Monsieur Renard
cast.look: an anthropomorphic sly red fox banker standing upright, narrow yellow eyes, a crooked smile, a tailored charcoal suit with a pocket square, a gold watch

lines.text: Signe ici, Bruno. Je sauve ton garage.

scenes.visual_prompt: Monsieur Renard, falsely friendly, lays a contract on the hood of an old car in a small village garage at golden hour; Bruno wipes his hands on a rag. Medium shot, warm golden light
scenes.motion_prompt: Renard slides the contract and a pen toward Bruno with a smile. Birds, a distant tractor.

lines.text: Merci, Monsieur Renard. Vous êtes un ami.

scenes.visual_prompt: Bruno, grateful, signs the contract without reading it while little Tom plays with a big wrench on the garage floor. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: Bruno signs quickly and smiles, Tom spins the wrench. Pen scratching, happy puppy giggle.

scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of the contract's tiny print on the hood of the old car in the village garage, under Monsieur Renard's paw, his crooked smile blurred behind, golden light
scenes.motion_prompt: The camera slides along the tiny print, Renard's smile sharpens. Tense strings.

lines.text: Un jour de retard, Bruno. Le garage est à moi.

scenes.visual_prompt: Monsieur Renard, satisfied, plants a red and white sign reading "VENDU" in front of the garage while Bruno watches, devastated. Wide shot, grey day
scenes.motion_prompt: Renard hammers the sign into the ground and dusts off his paws. Hammer blows.

scenes.visual_prompt: Tom, crying, hugs his father's leg in front of the sold garage. Close-up at puppy height
scenes.motion_prompt: Tom squeezes the leg, Bruno's paw rests on his head. Soft piano.

lines.text: Je le rachèterai, fils. Même s'il faut porter mille valises.

scenes.visual_prompt: Bruno, exhausted but determined, carries heavy suitcases on a rainy train station platform at night, bent under the weight. Medium shot, cold neon light
scenes.motion_prompt: He lifts two suitcases with effort, rain falls behind him. Rain and a train horn.

lines.text: T'as porté combien de valises aujourd'hui ?

scenes.visual_prompt: Tom waits on a station bench at night holding a thermos, and smiles when Bruno arrives soaked. Medium shot, warm station lamp
scenes.motion_prompt: Tom jumps off the bench and holds out the thermos. Rain, a distant train.

scenes.visual_prompt: Bruno, smiling tiredly, drinks from the thermos next to Tom on the station bench. Close-up two-shot
scenes.motion_prompt: Steam rises from the cup, Tom leans on his father's arm. Soft piano.

scenes.visual_prompt: A glass jar full of coins on a kitchen table grows fuller, Bruno thinner and Tom a little taller behind it, seasons changing in the window. Medium shot, warm lamp
scenes.motion_prompt: Coins drop into the jar one by one, the light in the window changes from autumn to winter. Coins clinking, soft piano.

scenes.visual_prompt: Monsieur Renard, panicked and soaked, stands next to his smoking luxury car broken down on a dark country road during a violent storm, phone without signal. Wide shot, lightning
scenes.motion_prompt: Lightning flashes, smoke rises from the hood, he waves his phone in the air. Thunder and heavy rain.

scenes.visual_prompt: Bruno gets out of his old pick-up truck, headlights cutting through the storm, and looks at Monsieur Renard in silence. Medium shot, headlights and rain
scenes.motion_prompt: The pick-up door opens, Bruno stands still in the rain, staring. Rain, an idling engine.

lines.text: Papa… c'est lui qui nous a tout pris. On le laisse ?

scenes.visual_prompt: Tom, angry, looks through the rainy windshield of the pick-up at the fox by the road. Close-up inside the cab
scenes.motion_prompt: Tom presses his paws on the dashboard, wipers sweep the rain. Rain on the roof.

lines.text: Non, fils. On ne devient pas comme ceux qui nous blessent.

scenes.visual_prompt: Bruno, calm, opens his toolbox on the wet road in the headlights. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: He takes out a wrench and rolls up his sleeves. Rain, toolbox clatter.

scenes.visual_prompt: Bruno repairs the engine under the storm while Monsieur Renard watches, ashamed, holding his coat over his head. Medium shot, headlights
scenes.motion_prompt: Bruno works with the wrench, Renard lowers his eyes. Rain and metal sounds.

scenes.visual_prompt: Bruno, kind, looks up at Monsieur Renard from under the car hood on the dark country road, in the storm and the headlights. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: Bruno smiles softly, the rain slows down. Rain easing.

lines.text: Le garage est à toi, Bruno. Il l'a toujours été.

scenes.visual_prompt: The engine roars back to life; Monsieur Renard pulls the contract out of his briefcase and tears it in two in the headlights on the dark country road, in the rain. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: He tears the paper slowly, the pieces fly in the wind. Engine starting, paper tearing.

scenes.visual_prompt: Tom, joyful, hangs the last letters of a freshly painted sign 'BRUNO & FILS' above the village garage on a sunny morning. Low angle, bright morning light
scenes.motion_prompt: Tom hooks the last letter and raises his paws in victory. Birds, cheerful music.

scenes.visual_prompt: Bruno and Tom, grease on their snouts, laugh together in front of their garage in golden light, the same place as the beginning. Wide shot
scenes.motion_prompt: They laugh and bump fists, slow pull-back on the garage. Laughter, warm music.

on_screen_text.fr: La bonté, seule vengeance qui rend plus grand
